page.title: Start a support session
page.intro: Someone helping you with this computer asked you to open this page. Nothing happens until you download and run the program yourself.

code.heading: Enter the code you were given
code.help: The person helping you will read out a code of 9 letters and numbers, like KTM-4H7-P2X. Capitals and dashes do not matter.
code.label: Support code
code.formatError: That is not a complete code yet. A code has 9 letters and numbers, for example KTM-4H7-P2X.

invalid.title: That code no longer works
invalid.body: A support code stops working a short time after it is created, and it can only be used once. Ask the person helping you to read out a new code, then type it in above.

checkFailed.title: The code could not be checked
checkFailed.body: The connection to the internet may have dropped. Check your connection and try the code again.

download.manualFallback: If the download prompts for a code, enter: {{code}}
download.macosBody: The program is not ready for Mac computers yet. Ask the person helping you what to do instead.

windowsPrompt.title: Windows will ask you before it runs
windowsPrompt.body: When you open the file, Windows shows a prompt asking whether you want to allow it to run. The file is digitally signed, so that prompt names a publisher: it should read {{publisher}}. If it says the publisher is unknown, or names anyone you were not expecting, close the prompt and call the person helping you instead of continuing.

trust.title: What the program does
trust.seeScreen: While the session is running, the person helping you can see your screen.
trust.temporary: The program runs once and then removes itself. Nothing stays installed on this computer.
trust.stopAnyTime: You can stop sharing whenever you want by closing the program window.
trust.onlyIfExpected: If you were not expecting this, do not run it. Close this page and contact the support people you normally deal with.
